kathy.name: Kathy
kathy.role: case subject — the quality engineer who tells a panicking client no and lands in the top 10% doing it

maria.name: Maria
maria.role: case subject — the mortgage specialist who says yes to every file and lands in the bottom 41%

terry.name: Terry
terry.role: case subject — the loader who squares every box on purpose, loses his own per-minute metric and makes the whole dock faster

james.name: James
james.role: case subject — the swamped consultant who makes the boss choose instead of quietly doing both

partner.name: The Senior Partner
partner.role: case subject — the man with immense structural power over James who hands him a second project

susan.name: Susan
susan.role: case subject — the head hunter who turns down a fortune rather than break the one rule her firm set

coke-exec.name: The Coca-Cola Executive
coke-exec.role: case subject — the client across the table whose money Susan declines; the status the refusal costs

anne.name: Anne
anne.role: case subject — the nurse manager who asks the stupid question that removes a step and saves lives

greg-green.name: Principal Greg Green
greg-green.role: case subject — the principal who flips a 300-year-old school model instead of asking teachers to work harder

andy-sheiel.name: Andy Sheiel
andy-sheiel.role: case subject — the social-studies teacher whose hardest class becomes the proof that the flipped model is safe

jiro.name: Jiro Ono
jiro.role: case subject — the 91-year-old three-star chef whose inner score costs fifty minutes of octopus massage

apprentice.name: Jiro's Apprentice
apprentice.role: case subject — the young cook who massages one octopus for fifty minutes and throws away 200 failed omelets

samantha.name: Samantha
samantha.role: case subject — the airport rental clerk whose purpose turns a transaction into a rescue mission

amundsen.name: Roald Amundsen
amundsen.role: case subject — the explorer who brought one thing and nothing else: 52 Greenland dogs, chosen after two winters of research

scott.name: Captain Robert Falcon Scott
scott.role: case subject — the counter-example: five kinds of transport, no backup able to move, the complexity trap frozen

designer.name: The Abstract Artist
designer.role: case subject — the graphic designer who followed pure passion into personal bankruptcy: passion without purpose

hp-engineer.name: The Status-Report Engineer
hp-engineer.role: case subject — the model employee whose meticulous weekly reports land on a server nobody opens

picker.name: The Monitored Picker
picker.role: case subject — the warehouse picker timed to the second by an algorithm, the worker the counterpoint is about
